theorems.name: Submission.frt_vgm_measurable_plane_selection
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), Nonempty (Grassmannian N n) → ∃ τ : Euclidean N → Grassmannian N n, Measurable τ ∧ ∀ (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n), (∀ β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (∫ z in closedBall x ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / (V.weight (closedBall x ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (β T))) → τ x = T
